description.en: The USB Type-C receptacle interface: a 24-pin, 0.5 mm-pitch tongue inside a shell opening 8.34 × 2.56 mm that takes a Type-C plug either way up. A device's port cutout is sized from it and from the plug's overmold.
description.es: La interfaz del receptáculo USB Tipo C: una lengüeta de 24 pines a paso de 0.5 mm dentro de una abertura de carcasa de 8.34 × 2.56 mm que recibe una clavija Tipo C en cualquiera de sus dos posiciones. El recorte del puerto de un aparato se dimensiona a partir de ella y del sobremoldeo de la clavija.
description.fr: L'interface de l'embase USB Type-C : une languette de 24 broches au pas de 0,5 mm dans une ouverture de blindage de 8,34 × 2,56 mm qui reçoit une fiche Type-C dans les deux sens. La découpe du port d'un appareil se dimensionne d'après elle et d'après le surmoulage de la fiche.
description.pt: A interface do receptáculo USB Tipo C: uma lingueta de 24 pinos com passo de 0,5 mm dentro de uma abertura de blindagem de 8,34 × 2,56 mm que recebe uma ficha Tipo C nos dois sentidos. O recorte da porta de um aparelho dimensiona-se a partir dela e do sobremoldado da ficha.

governing.designation: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.5

sources.title: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification, Release 2.5 (March 2026)
sources.supports: Figure 3-1 (receptacle interface): shell opening 8.34 +0.06/−0.02 wide, 2.56 ±0.04 high; shell length 6.20 REF (6.20 ±0.20 effective when mounted, note 7); tongue 6.690 +0.045/−0.055 wide, 4.45 ±0.10 long, 0.70 ±0.05 thick over the contacts; signal contact pitch 0.5; §3.2.3: 24 pins. Figures 3-3 and 3-12 (plug interface): shell 8.25 ±0.03 wide, 2.40 ±0.03 high, 6.65 ±0.10 from the overmold face to the tip; overmold 12.85 max wide, 7.0 max high. §2.1 and §2.3.2: the plug mates either way up. Figure 3-82 (informative): the overmold face stays at least 0.05 off the product surface when the plug is fully seated. Figure 3-81 (informative): ports at least 7.50 apart stacked, 13.35 side by side, centre to centre. Note 8: a 1.5 min lead-in if the receptacle shell is modified

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the shell opening on the receptacle's front (mating) face. +z points out of the opening, toward a plug; +x runs along the opening's width; +y = z × x runs along its height. The body behind the face lies at z < 0.

shell_length.note: REF in Figure 3-1; ±0.20 is note 7's effective length when mounted in a product

plug_overmold_width_max.note: the opening an enclosure leaves must clear the plug's overmold

overmold_to_enclosure_gap_min.note: informative (Figure 3-82): the seated plug's overmold face to the product surface

shell_lead_in_min.note: note 8: only where the receptacle shell is modified for an enclosure

interfaces.note: Female: a Type-C plug enters the shell opening. Symmetry 2: the plug mates either way up (§2.1). Framed on the shell's front face; where the plug's overmold face sits when seated is not one cited number, so a mate seats it on this face, a convention.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The USB Type-C specification is free from the USB-IF document library. It gives no normative outside envelope for the receptacle (the mid-mount and other footprints are informative) and no numeric panel cutout, so the body is not modelled; the enclosure facts above are what a port cutout reads.
